name: Diverse Recommendations
description: Users want a more diverse and dynamic music recommendation system that suggests songs similar to their listening preferences. This need arises from the repetitive and uninteresting recommendations provided by the current algorithm.

name: Intuitive Discovery UI
description: Users desire a simplified and intuitive user interface for music discovery, allowing them to easily find and explore new music. The current UI is cluttered and confusing, hindering the discovery process.

name: Social Music Sharing
description: Users want an in-app social layer for music discovery and sharing, enabling them to share music with friends and discover new songs. This need is driven by the lack of social features in the current app.

name: Transparent Recommendation
description: Users want to understand why certain songs are recommended to them, seeking transparency in the recommendation algorithm. This need stems from the lack of explanation for the recommended songs.

name: Personalized Playlists
description: Users desire personalized playlists that cater to their mood, activity, or preferences, providing a more enjoyable listening experience. The current playlists are not tailored to individual tastes.
